title: Omuyita okuva mu Buziba
intro: Teebereza emmeeme eyakwasibwa obubaka obw’obwakatonda, naye nga mu kaseera katono ak’amangu, yava ku bantu baabwe awatali lukusa lwa lwatu. Olugendo luno lwabatuusa mu kugezesebwa okw’ekitalo, okugezesebwa okw’amaanyi okw’obugumiikiriza n’okwesigamira ku Oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo. Ani ono ssekinnoomu emboozi ye etuyigiriza ku kwenenya n’obunene bw’okusaasira kwa Allah?
clues: Nnasindikibwa mu ggwanga eddene, naye okugaana kwabwe okwasooka kwandeetera okunyigirizibwa.
Nava ku bantu bange, nga nkkiririza nti omulimu gwange guwedde, nga sinnafuna kiragiro kitegeerekeka bulungi okusimbula.
Nnanoonya okuyita ku mmeeri, naye omuyaga ogw’amaanyi n’okukuba akalulu byaleetawo embeera ey’amaanyi.
Nasuulibwa mu nnyanja, ekitonde eky’amaanyi eky’omu buziba ne kinmira.
Mu kizikiza ky’olubuto lwayo, nakoowoola Allah, nga nkiriza ekibi kyange era nga nnoonya okusonyiyibwa kwe.
Allah yalagira ekitonde ekyo okunsuula ku lubalama, ne nzzibwa obulamu wansi w’ekimera eky’enjawulo.
verse: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy. (37:142)
